### To be removed when PR is created
**:memo: IMPORTANT: Please do not create a Pull Request without creating an issue first.**
- _Any changes needs to be discussed before proceeding, failure to do so may result in the rejection of the pull request._
- _Go throw [Pull request guidelines](./../docs/guidelines/pull-request-guidelines.md) if you are not aware of them._

## Pull Request Title
- Short and descriptive (e.g., "Fix issue with login form validation")

## Description
- Provide a brief description of what this PR does, including the problem it solves or the feature it adds.
- Mention any dependencies or related tickets/issues.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Project Configuration
- [ ] Repository Configuration
- [ ] Documentation update - Code guide/ docs (_like, javadoc or api_)
- [ ] Other (please describe):

## Screenshots / GIFs / Media (if applicable)
- Attach relevant screenshots or GIFs to help reviewers understand the UI or UX changes.

## How Has This Been Tested?/ Test Plan
- Describe the testing that you conducted, such as unit tests, integration tests, or manual testing.
- Mention any relevant testing tools or configurations.

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the project’s [coding guidelines](./../../docs/guidelines/coding-guides/). 
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented on my code where necessary.
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation (if applicable).
- [ ] I have added tests that verify the functionality of the code (if applicable).
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass.

## How to use/ enable
- Describe/ guide if any additional adaptions are necessary to use this feature/ changes.

## Additional Notes
- Add any additional information that could be useful to the reviewer.

## Closing issues
- Link any relevant issues here (e.g., `Closes #123`).
<!-- Put closes #XXXX in your comment to auto-close the issue that your PR fixes (if such). -->
